npc.terracraft.arms_dealer.dialogue.1: Hey %s. Looking to make things go bang? You've come to the right man.
npc.terracraft.arms_dealer.dialogue.2: Guns don't care how strong your arms are. That's what I like about them.
npc.terracraft.arms_dealer.dialogue.3: Musket balls are cheap. Missing is expensive.
npc.terracraft.arms_dealer.dialogue.4: Keep your powder dry and your eyes open.
npc.terracraft.arms_dealer.dialogue.5: Every gun I sell comes with a promise: it will shoot something.
npc.terracraft.arms_dealer.dialogue.6: The Nurse keeps asking me to stop. I keep asking her to buy something.
npc.terracraft.clothier.dialogue.1: Thank you for releasing me, %s. I feel like a new man.
npc.terracraft.clothier.dialogue.2: I remember nothing of the time I spent cursed... only the cold.
npc.terracraft.clothier.dialogue.3: A man is judged by his clothes. And by whether he's a giant floating skull.
npc.terracraft.clothier.dialogue.4: If you find any silk, bring it to me. I can work wonders with it.
npc.terracraft.clothier.dialogue.5: The Dungeon is yours to explore now. Mind the spikes.
npc.terracraft.clothier.dialogue.6: Sometimes I still hear the bones rattling down there.
npc.terracraft.demolitionist.dialogue.1: Ah, %s! Nothing like the smell of fresh powder in the morning.
npc.terracraft.demolitionist.dialogue.2: Rock in your way? Not for long, it isn't.
npc.terracraft.demolitionist.dialogue.3: Mind your step. And your eyebrows.
npc.terracraft.demolitionist.dialogue.4: Every problem's a nail, and I've got the biggest hammer there is.
npc.terracraft.demolitionist.dialogue.5: Underground's full of riches. You just have to ask it nicely. Loudly.
npc.terracraft.demolitionist.dialogue.6: Careful with the merchandise. Very careful.
npc.terracraft.dryad.dialogue.1: Greetings, %s. The land is restless - can you feel it?
npc.terracraft.dryad.dialogue.2: Something vile spreads beneath this world. My powder can push it back, a little at a time.
npc.terracraft.dryad.dialogue.3: Every tree you plant is a promise to the world.
npc.terracraft.dryad.dialogue.4: The Corruption and the Crimson are wounds. Wounds can be healed.
npc.terracraft.dryad.dialogue.5: I have watched these forests for longer than you would believe.
npc.terracraft.dryad.dialogue.6: Be gentle with the land, and it will be gentle with you.
npc.terracraft.goblin_tinkerer.cannot_re: Hold a weapon, a tool or an accessory and I'll reforge it.
Hey, %s. Need something fixed? Or improved? I do both. For a price.
Goblins are great at two things: tinkering and making a mess. I specialise in the first one.
Bring me your gear and some coin and I'll give it a new edge. No promises it's a better one.
A Tinkerer's Workshop lets you combine accessories. Two for the price of one slot!
My old army keeps coming back. Don't worry, I don't take it personally.
Rocket science? I'm more of a rocket boots kind of goblin.
npc.terracraft.goblin_tinkerer.reforged: There you go - %s! Much better. Probably.
npc.terracraft.goblin_tinkerer.rescued: Thanks, %s! Those goblins left me tied up down here. I'll find a place in your town.
npc.terracraft.goblin_tinkerer.too_poor: That'll cost %s. Come back when your purse is heavier.
npc.terracraft.guide.dialogue.1: Hello, %s. If you're new here, chop some trees and build a shelter before nightfall.
npc.terracraft.guide.dialogue.2: Gel from slimes and a little wood make torches. You'll want plenty of light underground.
npc.terracraft.guide.dialogue.3: Stars fall from the sky at night. Collect them before sunrise - they're worth more than they look.
npc.terracraft.guide.dialogue.4: Life Crystals glow deep in the caverns. Each one makes you a little sturdier.
npc.terracraft.guide.dialogue.5: Build more houses and more people will come to live here. A home needs walls, a door, a light, a chair and a table.
npc.terracraft.guide.dialogue.6: Something watches from the dark... They say enough lenses could call it down on you.
npc.terracraft.guide.dialogue.7: A Work Bench is the first thing every builder needs. Press V near one to see what you can make.
npc.terracraft.guide.dialogue.8: I keep hearing stories about an enormous slime wearing a crown. Ridiculous, surely.
npc.terracraft.guide.help.1: Press V to open the crafting menu. It shows everything you can make with the stations around you.
npc.terracraft.guide.help.10: Carry some explosives, and a Demolitionist may take an interest in your town.
npc.terracraft.guide.help.11: Use a Housing Query on a room to check whether someone could live there.
npc.terracraft.guide.help.12: Twenty gel and five gold or platinum bars make a Slime Crown. Use it if you dare.
npc.terracraft.guide.help.13: The Dungeon lies to the %s. An old man guards its door - speak to him at night, if you are strong enough.
npc.terracraft.guide.help.2: Press R to open your equipment. Accessories go in the slots next to your armor.
npc.terracraft.guide.help.3: Your pickaxe's power decides what you can mine. Obsidian needs something stronger than copper.
npc.terracraft.guide.help.4: Each world has copper or tin, iron or lead, silver or tungsten, and gold or platinum. Look around!
npc.terracraft.guide.help.5: Life Crystals raise your maximum life by 20. You can use fifteen of them.
npc.terracraft.guide.help.6: Magic weapons use mana, which slowly refills. Mana Crystals raise your maximum.
npc.terracraft.guide.help.7: Enemies drop coins. If you die, you'll drop half of the coins you carry.
npc.terracraft.guide.help.8: The Merchant will move in once someone has saved 50 silver and there is an empty house.
npc.terracraft.guide.help.9: The Nurse comes once the Merchant lives here and someone has used a Life Crystal.
npc.terracraft.mechanic.dialogue.1: Wire is cheaper than you'd think, %s. Want to build something that goes click?
npc.terracraft.mechanic.dialogue.2: That old man had me locked up down there for ages. I spent the time rewiring his traps.
npc.terracraft.mechanic.dialogue.3: Levers, pressure plates, repeaters... give me a pile of redstone and an afternoon.
npc.terracraft.mechanic.dialogue.4: If it moves and shouldn't, that's a job for the wrench. If it doesn't and should, that's a job for wire.
npc.terracraft.mechanic.dialogue.5: My brother tinkers with goblin gadgets. I prefer things that actually stay in one piece.
npc.terracraft.mechanic.dialogue.6: A good trap starts with a good pressure plate. Trust me, I've stepped on enough of them.
npc.terracraft.mechanic.rescued: Thank you, %s! I'd have been stuck in that dungeon forever. I'll set up shop in your town.
npc.terracraft.merchant.dialogue.1: Welcome, %s! Coin talks, and I'm a very good listener.
npc.terracraft.merchant.dialogue.2: Torches, potions, arrows - the essentials of a long and happy life. Mostly long.
npc.terracraft.merchant.dialogue.3: Everything you carry is worth something to somebody. Usually me.
npc.terracraft.merchant.dialogue.4: Prices are fair, friend. Fair to me, at least.
npc.terracraft.merchant.dialogue.5: Out exploring after dark? Then you'll want to buy something. Trust me.
npc.terracraft.merchant.dialogue.6: Bring me your odds and ends - I'll pay a fifth of what they're worth!
npc.terracraft.nurse.dialogue.1: Hold still, %s. This might sting. A lot.
npc.terracraft.nurse.dialogue.2: You look terrible. That's not an insult, it's a diagnosis.
npc.terracraft.nurse.dialogue.3: I patch people up. I don't do miracles - but I'm close.
npc.terracraft.nurse.dialogue.4: Please stop running headfirst into slimes.
npc.terracraft.nurse.dialogue.5: My services aren't free, but your life is worth the coin. Probably.
npc.terracraft.nurse.dialogue.6: Back again? You must enjoy my company. Or bleeding.
npc.terracraft.nurse.healthy: You look perfectly healthy. Come back when something's broken.
npc.terracraft.nurse.too_poor: Healing you would cost %s. I don't work for free, you know.
npc.terracraft.old_man.day: My master cannot be summoned under the light of day.
npc.terracraft.old_man.dialogue.1: I cannot let you enter until you free me of my curse.
npc.terracraft.old_man.dialogue.2: Come back at night if you wish to enter.
npc.terracraft.old_man.dialogue.3: My master cannot be summoned under the light of day.
npc.terracraft.old_man.dialogue.4: You are far too weak to defeat my curse. Come back when you aren't so worthless.
npc.terracraft.old_man.dialogue.5: You pathetic fool. You cannot hope to face my master as you are now.
npc.terracraft.pirate.dialogue.1: Arrr, %s! Ye look like a landlubber who could use a cannonball or two.
npc.terracraft.pirate.dialogue.2: Me ship? Sunk, matey. Ye scallywags sent it to Davy Jones' locker. No hard feelings.
npc.terracraft.pirate.dialogue.3: That ghost ship still haunts me dreams. The Dutchman never pays its crew, ye know.
npc.terracraft.pirate.dialogue.4: Treasure be not always gold. Sometimes it be a fine hat. Want one?
npc.terracraft.pirate.dialogue.5: Keep yer coins close and yer Lucky Coin closer, I always say.
npc.terracraft.pirate.dialogue.6: Yo ho! What be the difference between a pirate and a merchant? About three cannons.
npc.terracraft.steampunker.dialogue.1: Ello, %s! Fancy a bit of gadgetry? I've got just the thing for those pesky biomes.
npc.terracraft.steampunker.dialogue.2: My Clentaminator sprays solutions far and wide. Green cleans, the others... don't.
npc.terracraft.steampunker.dialogue.3: You beat one of those mechanical monstrosities? Smashing! I'd love a look at the scrap.
npc.terracraft.steampunker.dialogue.4: Brass, steam and a bit of elbow grease. That's all a girl needs.
npc.terracraft.steampunker.dialogue.5: Mind the purple solution. It gets everywhere, and I do mean everywhere.
npc.terracraft.steampunker.dialogue.6: Tick, tock, tick, tock. Everything runs on gears if you look closely enough.
npc.terracraft.witch_doctor.dialogue.1: The jungle speaks, %s. Today it says you look tired.
npc.terracraft.witch_doctor.dialogue.2: The Queen of the hive is gone. Her stingers are mine now. Perhaps yours, for a price.
npc.terracraft.witch_doctor.dialogue.3: When the world turns dark and strange, leaves can carry you to the sky. Come back at night.
npc.terracraft.witch_doctor.dialogue.4: Do not touch the masks. They remember who touched them.
npc.terracraft.witch_doctor.dialogue.5: Bees know many things. Mostly about flowers. Still, many things.
npc.terracraft.witch_doctor.dialogue.6: Your aura is... green. That is either very good or very bad.
npc.terracraft.wizard.dialogue.1: Greetings, %s. Would you care for a lesson in the arcane? No? Then perhaps a potion.
npc.terracraft.wizard.dialogue.2: I once turned a slime into a slightly larger slime. It was the proudest day of my life.
npc.terracraft.wizard.dialogue.3: A Spell Tome is the beginning of every great magic weapon. The ending, too, if you're careless.
npc.terracraft.wizard.dialogue.4: The spirits of light and dark walk the land now. Mind the Hallow - it is beautiful, and it bites.
npc.terracraft.wizard.dialogue.5: Mana is like soup. You should always have more than you think you need.
npc.terracraft.wizard.dialogue.6: Do you hear that ringing? No? Good. Neither do I. Probably.
npc.terracraft.wizard.rescued: Ah, %s! The spell I was casting on myself went... sideways. Thank you. I'll see myself to your town.
